title: GTA 6 Price in India: Second Cheapest Globally at ₹5,999
description: GTA 6 price in India is ₹5,999 for the Standard Edition, the second-lowest worldwide after Japan, according to IGN India. Here is how it compares.

body.text: The GTA 6 price in India works out to ₹5,999 for the Standard Edition, which makes it the second-cheapest in the world once converted to US dollars, according to IGN India. With the game launching this week, the numbers matter to every Indian player deciding whether to buy on day one. But as the report points out, a low sticker price does not tell the whole story.
GTA 6 price in India vs the rest of the world

IGN India cites a comparison shared on X by user @loadingdoselord. In it, India's Standard Edition price converts to about $62.60. Only Japan is lower, at roughly $62.42 (around ₹5,800). The gap between the two is tiny.
At the other end, the report lists the most expensive markets:

items: Israel: around $103.79 (~₹9,700), the highest on the list

body.text: Note that this is a comparison from a fan post, picked up by IGN India. It is not an official price table from Rockstar Games.
Cheaper does not always mean more affordable

IGN India stresses that purchasing power changes the picture. A $60 game may feel manageable to someone earning in dollars, but it can eat a far bigger share of an Indian gamer's monthly income. Likewise, a price above $100 in Israel or Norway does not automatically mean the game is harder to afford there, because average earnings are higher.
In short, India gets a lower price, but what that price means in real terms depends on where you live and what you earn.

On both PS5 and Xbox, the Standard Edition costs ₹5,999 in India, while the Ultimate Edition is priced at ₹7,499, as per the report. Preloading is already live on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with a download size of 212GB. If you are on a limited data plan or a shared connection, that is worth planning for before launch day.

Demand looks enormous. IGN India says the latest Sensor Tower data suggests GTA 6 has passed $1 billion in pre-orders, with an estimated 10.31 million units sold before launch. These are estimates from a third-party tracker, not figures confirmed by the publisher.
A bigger Xbox and Take-Two link-up

In related news mentioned by IGN India, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has announced a "10-year strategic partnership" with GTA 6 publisher Take-Two Interactive. The report does not go into details, so what it means for players is still unclear.

Launch is only days away, so the next things to watch are how smoothly preloads and unlocks go on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and whether any more pre-order or sales figures surface. Also keep an eye on how Indian players respond to the ₹5,999 price in practice: whether most go for the Standard Edition or stretch to the ₹7,499 Ultimate Edition. We will update as more confirmed information arrives.

sources.title: GTA 6 Is Cheaper in India Than Almost Anywhere Else in the World
